mechanism: Tricyclic antidepressant combined with MAOI increases risk of serotonin syndrome, hypertensive crisis, and cardiac arrhythmias through additive monoaminergic effects.
action: Contraindicated combination - do not use together; allow 14-day washout after MAOI discontinuation before starting nortriptyline, or 7 days after nortriptyline before starting MAOI.
